info.name: rental-engine: EPC Open Data Communities
info.description:
EPC (Energy Performance Certificate) API used by the rental-engine pipeline for enrichment.

Auth: HTTP Basic. Username = {{EPC_EMAIL}}, Password = {{EPC_API_KEY}}.
Base URL: https://epc.opendatacommunities.org/api/v1/domestic

This collection was motivated by the discovery that the original integration used only 1 of 20+ fields the API returns. The Wave 1 Agent B refactor adds address matching (fuzzy score against listing address) and ingests 18 additional EPC-derived fields including total-floor-area, SAP scores, build form, glazing, walls, heating cost, and lodgement date.

Key usage patterns:
- total-floor-area: primary source for size_sqft fallback (multiply by 10.7639)
- lodgement-date: tiebreak when multiple records match a postcode
- Address matching threshold: token-set ratio >= 0.6 via rapidfuzz

query.description: Hackney postcode with multiple residential records

request.description:
Multi-record postcode lookup. Returns all EPC certificates for the postcode.

Pipeline behaviour (Wave 1 Agent B): fetches up to 20 records, then fuzzy-matches each record's address1+address2+address3 against the listing's address field using rapidfuzz token_set_ratio. Accepts the highest-scoring match above 0.6. Tiebreaks on most-recent lodgement-date.

The total-floor-area field (in sqm) is used as the size_sqft fallback when the NLP extractor (Agent A) returns None: size_sqft = round(total_floor_area * 10.7639).
